title: Scavenger - Location, Weakness & How to Unlock the Fight
description: The Scavenger in Expedition 33's Falling Leaves is locked behind the Lady of Sap quest. Location, Light weakness, and what it drops.

sections.title: Overview
sections.content:
The Scavenger is an optional boss in Falling Leaves, an optional Act 2 zone on the western edge of The Continent, reachable once Esquie can swim through coral.

Unlike most optional bosses, you cannot simply walk up to it - it is locked behind a side quest.

sections.title: Unlocking the Scavenger Fight
sections.content:
1. Enter Falling Leaves and find the young boy behind a fenced-off gate
  2. Complete the Lady of Sap quest he gives you
  3. Return and speak to the boy again - he opens the gate
  4. Follow the path onward using the ropes and grapple points until you reach the upper Expedition Flag
  5. Walk toward the platform - a cutscene introduces the Scavenger

It is the boss at the very end of the Falling Leaves path.

sections.title: Weakness & Resistances
sections.content:
PropertyValue
Weak toLight (and Physical)
ResistsIce, Fire, Earth, Lightning
AbsorbsDark

Almost nothing works here. Light and Physical are your only real damage types, and Dark is absorbed.

sections.title: Rewards
sections.content:
• Scaverim weapon (Level 14, for Lune)
  • Resplendent Chroma Catalyst x3
  • 139,320 EXP
  • 8,020 Chroma
  • Additionally, talk to the young boy again afterwards to receive the Until Next Life music record

sections.title: How to Beat the Scavenger
sections.content:
Leave Lune and Sciel at home

The Scavenger is a Dark-based boss that absorbs Dark damage. Lune and Sciel are the two most Dark-oriented party members, which makes them actively worse than useless here - a Dark skill literally heals it.

Verso is the recommended pick. Build your team around Light and Physical damage and avoid AoE elemental skills that would feed it.

Check your weapons first

Because it resists four elements and absorbs a fifth, a poorly matched weapon loadout will make this fight take several times longer than it should. Swap to Light or Physical before you open the gate.
